## Blockers and outstanding acceptance criteria

- [ ] PR is draft.
- [ ] Work stays within the approved checkpoint.
- [ ] Test and implementation claims have evidence.
- [ ] Any pending work and later checkpoints are identified.

## Explicit acceptance criteria and scope boundaries

- [ ] This work fits one independently reviewable checkpoint or bounded slice.
- [ ] The project owner approved any material scope expansion or checkpoint consolidation.
- [ ] Assumptions, blockers, architectural deviations and unresolved decisions are recorded.
- [ ] Secret detection and applicable security scans ran with outcomes recorded.
- [ ] Required acceptance tests pass, including security-sensitive authorization, isolation, negative and failure cases where applicable.
- [ ] Checkpoint acceptance awaits the project owner. The PR will not merge automatically.
